title: AI Works
tagline: Rajasthan in Midjourney, a red reel, and a few short films.
summary: Personal AI work: a Rajasthan series shot in Midjourney and a red reel, followed by short films, an abstract short and an AI ad.

sections.label: The work
sections.title: Stories, looks and experiments, made for myself.
sections.body: Outside my day job I use generative AI to make images, reels and films for myself. The Rajasthan series and the red reel lead, followed by the short films: a Diwali zombie story set in Jaipur, an abstract short and an AI ad.

sections.label: Rajasthan
sections.title: Seven frames of Rajasthan, shot in Midjourney.
sections.body: Pink stone facades, shafts of light and lone figures: a seven-image series set in Rajasthan, made entirely in Midjourney. It first ran as an Instagram carousel.

sections.label: The red reel
sections.title: A reel in rust and red.
sections.body: A hand pressed against a weathered red wall, set to Dr. Dog's Where'd All the Time Go?

sections.caption: A reel set to Dr. Dog's Where'd All the Time Go?

sections.label: Houseparty
sections.title: An abstract AI short, with Socketman.
sections.body: A character with a retro monitor for a head runs through a room of pigeons and old electronics. Socketman echoes the electrical-accessory world of the Power series.

sections.label: Undying Light
sections.title: A Diwali clash between light and darkness.
sections.body: A short film where zombies haunt the vibrant streets of Jaipur, fully generated using AI tools. Making it taught me how much sound design matters in cinematic video: atmosphere, emotion, character voices, foley, music and sync all carry the film as much as the picture.

sections.label: Serum ad
sections.title: An AI ad for a personal-care serum.
sections.body: A product film made entirely with AI: close, glossy, and shot like a beauty campaign.

sections.label: Ultra-wide
sections.title: A reel in 5120×1080.
sections.body: Shorter pieces live on Instagram. This one is made in an ultra-wide frame.

sections.caption: Dance of the creator: an ultra-wide (5120×1080) AI reel
